summary: CONSOL AS (org. no. 983 745 741) is a private limited company (AS) based in Nordre Follo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2001-10-12. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 46.830 (Engroshandel med tømmer, trelast, byggevarer og sanitærutstyr). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 13.8 m and net income was -NOK 333 812. CEO: Rolf Andreas Mørck; board chair: Rolf Andreas Mørck; auditor: REVISJON CONSULT AS.
